posts.name: Bolt Forge
posts.tagline: Bolt's new agent with open-source models and 50X usage
posts.description: Bolt Forge is a new agent inside Bolt.new that runs on open-source models. Every Pro plan gets up to 50X more usage with no daily caps. Scores 91% of Bolt's top paid model on their internal benchmark.

posts.name: Mantra Timer
posts.tagline: A minimalist mantra meditation timer for iOS.
posts.description: Mantra Meditation Timer rejects the bloated tracking of modern wellness apps. Built for self-directed practitioners, this elegant iOS app offers a distraction-free experience with zero data collection. Enjoy core Meditation timers, calming chimes, and mental or physical check-ins completely free. For established pro mantra practitioners, a small one-off payment unlocks advanced stats and deeper customisation. No subscription fatigue, just a beautifully simple tool for profound daily practice.

posts.name: Steam Frame
posts.tagline: Your Steam library, now on a wearable PC
posts.description: Steam Frame is a wireless SteamOS headset that streams your whole library from a PC, Deck, or Machine, and runs standalone titles too. Dual radios plus an included adapter keep streaming stable. The controllers work as VR wands and a full gamepad.

posts.name: Lumiko
posts.tagline: Screen recordings that edit themselves with Auto Zoom-Pan
posts.description: Lumiko records your screen and edits the footage while you work. It tracks your cursor and clicks, then builds smooth zoom and pan moves over them automatically, no keyframes. Trim, split, and reorder clips on a timeline right in the browser. Smart Blur hides API keys and passwords in one drag. Add a webcam bubble, custom backgrounds, click effects. Exports up to 4K. Runs locally, no account, no upload queue. Free to start.

posts.name: Lull
posts.tagline: Tell it what is on your mind. It writes the meditation.
posts.description: Lull doesn't play recordings. Talk for a minute about what's actually going on and it writes a meditation for that moment, read in one of 11 voices. Oura recovery shapes the tone. Apple Watch records your heart rate and shows the real settle after, or nothing.

posts.name: Doneit 3.2
posts.tagline: Reimagined Doneit Assist, support for Siri AI, and more
posts.description: You can now attach photos when planning tasks with Doneit Assist to turn a handwritten list, whiteboard or a document into tasks, include additional details to make tasks more accurate, as well as let it suggest reminders and attributes for tasks, and break tasks into subtasks. Doneit Assist can now also create a brief summary of a task list, highlight its key tasks for you to focus on, as well as show the upcoming tasks in this list.

posts.name: VoiceCap
posts.tagline: The AI notetaker for meetings in your language
posts.description: Most AI notetakers are strong in English and mediocre in everything else. VoiceCap transcribes in 100+ languages and writes the summary, action items and decisions in that same language. Record in the room via native apps, send a bot to Zoom, Meet or Teams, or upload a file. Every meeting becomes a searchable record of what was decided and who owns it. Ask Claude or ChatGPT about it over MCP. EU company, recordings stored in Frankfurt, never used to train models. 300 free minutes, no card.

posts.name: Ruby UTCP
posts.tagline: The scalable, secure alternative to MCP for tool calling
posts.description: Ruby UTCP brings UTCP 1.1 to Ruby, giving apps and AI agents a standard way to discover and call tools over native protocols. It supports 12 transports, including HTTP, CLI, WebSocket, gRPC, GraphQL, MCP and WebRTC, plus streaming, auth, OpenAPI discovery, and CodeMode for programmable multi-tool workflows. Open source and built for the Ruby ecosystem.

posts.name: Squirrel
posts.tagline: An app blocker that pays you back
posts.description: Squirrel puts a price on the apps you open too much. Tap Instagram and you get a hard block, not a screen you can wave away. Want to check a DM? That's fine, but you have to open Squirrel, pick how long, and set aside a few dollars for yourself first. No money moves through the app. No card or bank account to connect. When you're ready, invest it in your own brokerage and tell Squirrel what you bought. It tracks your holdings with live prices.

posts.name: Basedash Models
posts.tagline: Define it once. Query it like a table.
posts.description: Basedash Models is a semantic workspace of reusable, governed SQL for core business concepts—customers, orders, active accounts—so everyone works from the same trusted definition. Each model has dedicated views for details, columns, measures, and segments, plus synonyms, row grain, relationships, and usage guidance the assistant reads when it answers. Reference a model in SQL like a table: select * from models.customers. Define it once. Query it like a table.

posts.name: Punch
posts.tagline: Save your group chat's important stuff
posts.description: You’re on vacation with your friends and you need to know the AirBnB address, the door code, the rendezvous spot, etc. Instead of scrolling through 100+ messages, save all that info on Punch and share with your friends and family. Why we're different: Notes App: This can fill up quick and can look clunky after a while. You also can’t share individual pieces from a note. Also, incompatibility between OS. Drive/Dropbox/etc.: Has the storage/shareability aspect, but is more geared toward storage.

posts.name: Mise
posts.tagline: The meal planner that gets all your dishes ready at once
posts.description: Recipes help you cook one dish. But meals have multiple dishes! Mise schedules every dish backwards from the minute you want to eat: one start time, one running order, a merged shopping list, a cooking mode. That way you get everything ready at the right time and can work from a simple prep list that includes ingredients, instructions, and reminders. Free with no login.

posts.name: BiBimba
posts.tagline: Clipboard history that can read your screenshots
posts.description: Clipboard history and screenshots, searchable together. BiBimba reads the text inside screenshots, so you can find a receipt total or an error message later and paste just what you need. On-device AI translates, summarizes, rewrites. Stays on your Mac. $9.

posts.name: Lappka
posts.tagline: Turn app screens into an App Store screenshots that converts
posts.description: Lappka helps mobile makers turn raw app screens into a conversion-focused App Store screenshots. Use AI for strategy and copy, then make every detail yours with editable templates, localization, App Store preview, and ready-to-export screenshots.

posts.name: NotchOwl
posts.tagline: Turn your Mac’s notch into a sleek productivity workspace.
posts.description: Tasks, notes, focus timers, and calendar events in your Mac’s notch. One hover away.

posts.name: LucentraCode
posts.tagline: Code without the Clock
posts.description: LucentraCode is an AI coding CLI built for developers who want powerful models without constantly worrying about usage limits or expensive subscriptions. Run it directly from your terminal, choose from models like GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, and more, and use them for real development work - debugging, building features, refactoring, testing, and working across larger codebases.

posts.name: One More Thing
posts.tagline: Turn doomscrolling into something worth knowing.
posts.description: One More Thing turns curiosity into a habit. Instead of endless scrolling through content you’ll forget, choose something you want to know and learn it one card at a time. Explore psychology, history, science, money, culture, languages, weird facts, and more. Every topic becomes a bite-sized learning deck you can swipe through in minutes. Earn XP, build streaks, unlock badges, and discover something new every day. Scroll less. Know more. There’s always One More Thing.

posts.name: Globenomics
posts.tagline: Explore 3D globe, 16 games, and 195 countries up for auction
posts.description: 16 geography games on a fully explorable 3D globe. Speedrun 195 countries, match capitals, guess flags, duel a friend and more Games pay you in GlobeMillions, and countries go to auction. Win one and you hold it for 24 hours: your avatar and name on that country, plus a note and one link to promote something, moderated before anyone sees it. Hold it longest, you're Country King. Click any country for GDP and wages, billionaires, unicorns, taxes, passport power, the Big Mac index and many more

posts.name: IronFuel for Android
posts.tagline: Now on Android: log a set, watch today's food target move
posts.description: Android lifters have been running a gym log and a calorie app that ignore each other. IronFuel joins them: log sets in three taps or by voice, photograph a meal, and when a session ends the day's calorie and protein target moves to match what you burned.

posts.name: Make Agent Fast
posts.tagline: Customer AI agents for small businesses. No code.
posts.description: Build a customer-facing AI agent from your website and documents, without code. Choose general assistance, sales, customer service, or booking; review its knowledge and test it before publishing. Embed it on your existing website or connect supported messaging channels. Answer questions, capture enquiries, hand conversations to a person, and review chats and usage in one dashboard. Voice and channel access vary by plan.

posts.name: Made with Jev
posts.tagline: What people are building on Jev
posts.description: Jev by TypeSafe is the new AI model that makes decisions instead of writing text, in under half a second. I'm building a directory to share all Jev related resources. Explore the insane things people built with it: browser agents, games, email triage, viral tweet analyzers. Each with its real cost. Plus a free AI slop detector and other tools coming.

posts.name: CreateMascot
posts.tagline: Consistent mascot illustrations for your app and launch
posts.description: Create a mascot from a product brief or upload your own. Approve its look, then generate matching illustrations for 404s, onboarding, empty states, social posts and launches. Not sure where to start? Add your website and describe your product to get three editable character directions. Choose from 15 asset formats and download sized PNGs.

posts.name: Worried Presenter
posts.tagline: AI Voice Presentation Coach Figma Plug-in for Designers
posts.description: AI Voice Presentation Coach designed for designers. Iterate, edit and improve your script. Even with a spoken feedback option. An educational tool that requires you need to set aside the time to be able to present your work and record your voice. Super helpful and would love your feedback. There is a feedback form link in the plug-in.

posts.name: Focus Firewall
posts.tagline: Block distracting websites while you work
posts.description: Focus Firewall blocks distracting websites and apps on your Mac while you work. Set your hours once and it runs by itself, in every major browser, with no extensions. New: the Browsing Report shows where your day went, hour by hour, with a focus score that leaves room for planned breaks. Also new: require Touch ID or password to stop blocking. No account, and nothing leaves your Mac. Free for 7 days.

posts.name: ReceiptVault: Warranty Tracker
posts.tagline: Keep your receipts. Never miss a warranty.
posts.description: ReceiptVault is a simple receipt and warranty tracker built to solve a problem I kept running into: finding a receipt when I actually needed it. Use AI-powered OCR to scan a receipt and automatically extract and fill details, then securely store your purchase records in the cloud. Organize receipts into folders, track warranty expiry dates, and get reminders before important warranties expire. All of this comes together in a clean, simple UI designed to make managing receipts feel effortless.

posts.name: flowy 2.0
posts.tagline: professional recorder & editor, now featuring on-device AI
posts.description: The 2.0 update introduces on-device AI integration, Audio Transcription and professional editing tools such as dynamic camera layouts, in-depth animations, speed adjustments, captions, media & annotations.

posts.name: BrainLoom 1.2
posts.tagline: The visual thinking canvas with built-in active recall
posts.description: BrainLoom is a visual workspace that unites reading, note-taking, and flashcards in one seamless system. Highlight any PDF or note to create flashcards instantly. With Linked Source, every card stays connected to its exact origin—letting you jump straight back to the original textbook paragraph or canvas node in one click. Now featuring multi-device Cloud Sync, freehand canvas sketching, custom project groups, and local-first privacy.

posts.name: Deiko
posts.tagline: Never worry about giving context from multiple screens now.
posts.description: Deiko follows your cursor and listens while you talk — any language, even two at once. Stop, and the exact screenshots plus a clear brief are ready to drop into Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. It's completely private and you need no accounts to onboard. Just install it and start using it and everything is local first.

posts.name: GEOFill
posts.tagline: GEO content to 10 platforms in one minute.
posts.description: Generate platform-native GEO articles and auto-fill Reddit, LinkedIn, Medium, Quora, DEV.to, Hashnode, and more with a Chrome extension. Shrink your daily workflow from 1 hour to 60 seconds.

posts.name: GaffGuide
posts.tagline: Instant, free UK home valuations
posts.description: Meet GaffGuide 🏡⚡ Ever wondered what your home—or the house down the street—is actually worth? Most sites show asking prices and spam you with estate agent calls. I built GaffGuide to fix that. Just enter any UK postcode for a free, instant market valuation backed by official HM Land Registry sales, certified floor space (m²), and local area stats. Zero calls. Zero fluff. Pure data in 3 seconds flat. Check your gaff today 👇 👉 GaffGuide.co.uk

posts.name: Fitycal: 3D Body Scan & Workout Plans
posts.tagline: 3D body scan in 10 seconds. A workout plan built from it.
posts.description: Fitycal turns a 10-second scan with your phone camera into a 3D avatar of your body, 25+ measurements and rated body metrics: body fat, lean mass, ratios. New in this launch: it builds a monthly workout plan from your own numbers. Four weeks of sessions with sets, reps and rest, matched to your goal and level, gym or living room, any exercise swappable in one tap. Rescan at the end of the month and the plan rebuilds around your new body. Compare scans side by side, export a PDF health report.

posts.name: Mufungo POS: Store & Inventory
posts.tagline: Welcome to Mufungo POS — point of sale for retail shops.
posts.description: Mufungo POS: Point of Sale is a cloud-synced register app, cash register, and real-time inventory management system built for retail store sales, stock tracking, and receipt printing. • Ring up sales and keep track of stock • Manage products, prices, and inventory • Invite staff and run your shop together • Print receipts on a Bluetooth thermal printer • Sign in with email or Google and sync your data securely Thank you for installing. We’re glad you’re here.

posts.name: Vajra - AI Enablement Audit
posts.tagline: Find out how much of your work AI could already do
posts.description: A free 3-minute audit that shows how much of your company's work AI could handle today versus what you're actually using — department by department, with a report you can act on.

posts.name: Planye
posts.tagline: Everything planner: tasks, habits, journal, money and more
posts.description: Planye is a digital planner built to replace a paper one: the pleasure of a beautiful notebook, with a memory that does not fall out of it. Week, Month and Year in one planner. Journal with photos, stickers and washi tape. Habits, lists, projects, shelf, money, cycle and mood, sealed capsules, home widgets. Themes, fonts and backgrounds to make it yours. Works offline and syncs across phone, tablet and browser. Start before you make an account. The free plan is real: no card, no time limit.

posts.name: mysetup.ai
posts.tagline: See how other people actually work with AI
posts.description: I built mysetup.ai because I kept wondering whether everyone else was getting more out of AI than I was. It’s a community for sharing the tools, agents and workflows behind what we build. Explore real setups, search for tools you’re curious about, and follow people as their setups change. Share yours through your agent via MCP or write it yourself in the web editor. You decide what goes public.

posts.name: Atlaria
posts.tagline: Your travels as photo albums on an interactive 3D globe
posts.description: Most travel apps are planners or feeds. Atlaria is a globe. Log a trip as a photo album and it becomes a pin on your own interactive 3D globe, with arcs linking the places you've been, and a countries list and travel passport that fill in on their own. Follow friends to see their globes and compare trips with a Travel Blend. Free, no ads, and GPS data is stripped from photos on your device before upload so you never publish your home address.

posts.name: Clixad
posts.tagline: Free AI coding agent for your terminal, no subscription
posts.description: Clixad is an AI coding agent for your terminal. Five models are free up to a daily limit, with no API key and no subscription. Need more? Answer short surveys to earn credits and spend them on premium models like Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.5. Made for people who code on the side or in bursts. Install with npm install -g clixad and sign in with GitHub.

posts.name: TypeMyVibe
posts.tagline: Decode your personality from how you actually text
posts.description: TypeMyVibe analyzes authentic conversation patterns instead of quiz answers to estimate MBTI, Enneagram, Big Five SLOAN, and moral Alignment. Every result connects real excerpts to its conclusions and generates a shareable Vibe Card plus a detailed report.

posts.name: NotchLive
posts.tagline: Live captions, transcription, and dictation. Local on Mac.
posts.description: Follow calls and videos with live captions, revisit recordings, or dictate into Mac apps. Speech recognition runs on your Mac, without a meeting bot. Review and correct speaker labels, then choose whether compatible AI tools can read your saved context or live captions through optional MCP access. Live captions are free; Pro is $24.99 once.

posts.name: Waivly - Networking Done Intentionally
posts.tagline: No performances or spam, just genuine connections
posts.description: Connect, learn, and grow in the private global network built for meaningful relationships, new opportunities, and lasting progress.

posts.name: PDF Editor 247
posts.tagline: PDF Editor 247 is the fast, secure way to edit your PDFs
posts.description: PDF Editor 247 is the fast, secure way to edit, convert, and manage your PDFs — right in your browser, no software required. Our Mission Working with PDFs shouldn't mean wrestling with clunky software or paying for tools you'll use once a month. Our mission is to put powerful, easy-to-use PDF tools within reach of anyone, anywhere — no downloads, no learning curve. Merge a contract, sign a form, compress a file: it should just work, in seconds.

posts.name: Upkeep
posts.tagline: WordPress maintenance reports without spreadsheet chaos
posts.description: Upkeep gives WordPress freelancers and small agencies one place to monitor plugin, theme and core updates, triage findings, and produce clear maintenance reports for clients. It replaces scattered checks and spreadsheet logs with scheduled syncs, priority alerts and a reusable audit trail. Upkeep is currently waitlist-only; the first release will focus on monitoring and reporting.

posts.name: AlphaProxy.AI
posts.tagline: The One Gateway For Every Model, Agent and Workflow
posts.description: AlphaProxy.AI is an intelligent orchestration layer that breaks down complex tasks into smaller, executable subtasks. It spins up ephemeral specialized subagents, assigns them roles in the main task, tools, skills, and dynamically selects relevant model per subagent from a Model Matrix of over 450+ open and closed LLMs and SLMs from 100+ providers. The result is execution with surgical precision, matching frontier labs' high quality at up to 70% cost reduction.

posts.name: Onefold
posts.tagline: Turn your design decisions into a DESIGN.md
posts.description: Onefold turns your colors, type, shape, shadows and voice into one DESIGN.md that Claude Code, Cursor and Codex follow. Start from your website or one brand color, keep or change every suggestion, and export CSS variables or a Tailwind theme. Free, no signup.

posts.name: LucidePixel
posts.tagline: A pixel-style icon toolkit built from Lucide
posts.description: Pixel-perfect icon toolkit built from Lucide. Open-source project exploring a crisp, blocky visual style derived from Lucide and Feather Icons. - Steellgold/lucide-pixel

posts.name: Tokyo Yamathon 2026
posts.tagline: Put your logo on a 42km Tokyo race Tee
posts.description: I'm walking 42 km through Tokyo, visiting all 30 Yamanote stations, for Tokyo Yamathon on Sat Oct 17, 2026. Put your logo on the T-shirt I wear.

posts.name: Postjamm - Forever free Frameio alt
posts.tagline: One place for video reviews, versions and client feedback
posts.description: Postjamm helps video agencies and editors review videos in one place. Share secure links, collect time-coded comments, annotations and voice notes, keep internal notes private, manage versions, and organize client feedback without messy email or chat threads.

posts.name: UGC Contract Template
posts.tagline: Generate a complete UGC creator contract in 60 seconds, free
posts.description: Most UGC deals still run on DMs and a Notion doc. This tool turns a 10-field form (deliverables, usage rights, term, exclusivity, payment, revisions, deadline, raw footage) into a full 11-clause contract you can copy, download as Word, or print. Every clause updates live as you change the deal terms, and a short guide explains what each clause means for a UGC deal. No signup, no ads, no email gate.

posts.name: NotchLive

posts.name: JSONaire
posts.tagline: Open large JSON files on Mac without your machine choking
posts.description: JSONaire is a native macOS app for opening and browsing huge JSON files, the kind that make Chrome DevTools, VS Code, or Electron viewers hang or crash. It memory-maps files instead of loading them into RAM, so a 4GB document opens in milliseconds and stays smooth at any depth. Includes native window tabs, fast search, copy in any format, and a table view for object arrays. Free up to 100MB, Pro unlocks unlimited size and all themes.

posts.name: TravelPal
posts.tagline: AI that answers guests at 2 AM and sells the late checkout
posts.description: TravelPal is an AI guest messaging and upsell tool for vacation rental property managers using Guesty, priced at $25 per unit per month. It answers at any hour, in the language the guest writes in, from your own listing data and message history. Then it sells: late checkout, early check-in and mid-stay cleaning, offered in the chat at your prices, paid by card, and written back into Guesty. Complaints and refund requests stop the AI and alert a person. Every stay also gets a guidebook.

posts.name: TypeMyVibe

posts.name: Try Emotica
posts.tagline: Say how you feel. Something starts playing. No signup.
posts.description: Try Emotica is a private space for how you feel. Name an emotion and watch it become part of your Mental Sky. Then choose what helps right now: a calming sound, a short guided exercise, or a few honest words. No questionnaire. No pressure. Just one small pause that can change the next minute.

posts.name: Waivly - Networking Done Intentionally

posts.tagline: Turn Instagram comments and DMs into paying customers
posts.description: Daeviq turns Instagram conversations into leads on autopilot. Automate comment replies, DMs, keyword triggers, follow-gates, welcome messages, and organize prospects in a built-in CRM. Unlike basic automation tools, Daeviq brings engagement, lead qualification, and customer management into one simple workflow—so creators and businesses can spend less time replying and more time growing.

posts.name: Agent Ops Club
posts.tagline: 8 open source AI Employees, plus the club to run them well
posts.description: Eight open source AI Employees, MIT licensed, on GitHub today: GTM Engineer, SEO, Web Dev, Social Media, Ad Manager, Sales, Customer Satisfaction and Chief of Staff. 59 scheduled routines that run on your own machine, on Claude Code or 10 other agents, and draft everything for your approval. Agent Ops Club is where you learn to run them, free to join. Pro and Lifetime add the Masterclass, 27 premium systems with a resale license, Sales Tools, and Hot Leads: up to 15 claimed leads a month.

posts.name: Rylaa
posts.tagline: Centralize tasks to finish your projects
posts.description: Rylaa helps you manage all your projects, tasks, and goals with clarity. Master your productivity, plan ahead, stay focused, and manage everything in one platform.

posts.name: ProgressGate
posts.tagline: Jev-powered circuit breaker for spinning AI agents
posts.description: ProgressGate uses TypeSafe Jev to detect when an AI agent is taking different actions without making real progress, then returns CONTINUE, WARN, REPLAN, or HALT decisions before the next model call.

posts.name: VantaUI
posts.tagline: Build product UI free from AI slop
posts.description: Discover production-grade site templates, app templates, components, blocks, and Figma files ready for LLMs, Next.js and React.

posts.name: tracing.tools
posts.tagline: Cookieless web analytics you can ask in plain language
posts.description: Cookieless web analytics with revenue attribution and an AI copilot you can ask in plain language. No cookie banner, one 4 kB script tag, data stored in the EU.

posts.name: Mochi Pop
posts.tagline: 60-second neon rhythm battles — free in your browser
posts.description: Mochi Pop is a cute rhythm game in a neon club. Tap, hold, and slide through 60-second remixes of public-domain classics — or battle 2-4 friends live with a room code. No install, no account.

posts.name: SayItErmano
posts.tagline: 100% local dictation for Linux
posts.description: Press a key, speak, and polished text lands in any app. 100% local speech-to-text, optional AI polish, native GTK 4. The community Linux port of FluidVoice.

posts.name: mWater Horizon
posts.tagline: Flood and heavy rainfall warnings for the entire world
posts.description: Horizon is a free app that tells you if you are in a floodplain and warns you when river flooding or heavy rainfall is predicted at your location. We combine daily forecasts from the Global Flood Awareness System (GloFAS), a global river model informed by satellite data, with flood-hazard maps. Since the model is global, it is especially useful in areas of the world without official flood forecasts or local weather predictions (always follow your local authorities).

posts.name: Woodbox
posts.tagline: Open-source database manager for developers
posts.description: Woodbox is a lightweight, open-source desktop database manager for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and React Native. A local-first workspace for everyday SQL.

posts.name: Video Atlas
posts.tagline: Browse and search videos across all your external drives
posts.description: Video Atlas brings videos from different folders and external drives into one library on your Mac, without moving your files. Browse indexed previews even when a drive is unplugged, so you can find a clip before reconnecting it. Search by scene or person, find similar videos, and review duplicates. AI processing runs locally on your Mac. An iPhone and iPad companion lets you browse, search, and stream from your Mac over your local network.

posts.name: atlaslet
posts.tagline: Short links, QR codes, bio pages and business cards
posts.description: Shorten long links, print QR codes you can re-point later, build a link-in-bio page and see Shorten links, print QR codes you can re-point later, build a link-in-bio page or a digital business card, and see every click with country, device and referrer. Your own domain, GA4 and Meta Pixel included. First 10,000 accounts get Pro free, forever. every click with country, device and referrer. The first 10,000 members get Pro free, forever.

posts.name: Vangrex
posts.tagline: Design, execute, and integrate AI workflows
posts.description: Vangrex is a developer-first platform for building and running AI workflows visually. Design workflows on a visual canvas, connect AI models and tools, add logic and data flow, and execute them without building the orchestration layer from scratch. Use the Vangrex SDK to integrate your workflows into your own applications. 🚀 Vangrex is currently in private beta and we're looking for developers to try it, build real workflows, and help shape what comes next.

posts.name: Memegenscript
posts.tagline: Free meme generator with an API, for AI agents and you
posts.description: Create memes online for free. Choose from 500+ popular meme templates, add your text & image, and download or share the image. Also available as an API.

posts.name: Trel.to
posts.tagline: Observability for web and mobile built for AI
posts.description: Logs, exceptions, traces, uptime monitoring, incidents, and status pages — one product, for backend services, web apps and Android/iOS/React Native apps. Open an error and land on the exact request that threw it. No query language. Built for AI.

posts.name: RepoHop
posts.tagline: Go between Grok Bot, Muse & others on the same local repo.
posts.description: Grok Bot ran out of tokens mid-task and my friend couldn’t get to the code it was working on. So I built RepoHop using Vibekit.dev. Your repo stays on your computer while Grok Bot, Muse and other remote agents work on the same local working tree. When one agent gets stuck, switch to another and keep going. No cloning repos. No moving files. No starting over.

posts.name: HiiScript
posts.tagline: open source offline-first screenplay writer
posts.description: Most screenwriters are outdated, paid, or cloud-only. Hiiscript is different: a free, MIT-licensed, offline-first screenplay editor for Windows, Linux, and Android. Scripts, characters, and scene suggestions stay on your device. No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Format scenes, add title pages, preview pagination, and export to Fountain or Markdown. Built with Electron and Capacitor by a Blender animator who couldn't find a tool that respected the same offline, open-source values.

posts.name: Semantic Space
posts.tagline: Explore a 2x2 matrix for any semantic concepts
posts.description: Map the meaning of anything. Choose any two concepts as axes, add words or phrases, and see how they relate to one another.

posts.name: TinySlate
posts.tagline: Stop paying monthly to find your own footage
posts.description: Hundreds of hours of footage, and you can never find the clip you need. TinySlate is a Mac app that uses AI or Apple's on-device models to tag your clips so you can search them like Spotlight. Most tools like this are built for studios — cloud, subscriptions, team seats. TinySlate's for solo shooters: footage stays on your Mac, no subscription, $45 once. Send your cut to FCP, Premiere, or Resolve.

posts.name: AI Study Sheet

posts.name: Pitikan
posts.tagline: A Filipino schoolyard pen-and-paper war, one flick per turn
posts.description: Before phones, Filipino kids fought wars on pad paper: hold a ballpen, press, flick. Wherever your line lands, that's your soldier. Cross an enemy's line and he's out; reach their corner, you win. Pitikan keeps it that way. One flick per turn — hold to build pressure, pull back like a slingshot, let go. Quick flicks are short and true; long holds go far but skid. Every line stays on the page as a wall. Each side hides a mine, a sniper and barbed wire. Play the Bot offline, or a friend by code.

posts.name: VocaLoop
posts.tagline: Mid-call data capture for voice agents
posts.description: Your voice agent asked for the email three times and still got it wrong. Or it gave up on the policy number. Or the address came back garbled. Tell your agent when to hand off, and Vocaloop does the rest: it generates a form for exactly the fields you're missing and delivers it mid-call over WhatsApp, SMS or email. The customer fills it while still talking, and clean structured data routes back into the conversation. No forms to build. Plugs into Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs and LiveKit.
